summary: Skratch shares his updated Temporal Vortex strategy after unlocking Max Difficulty Stage 20 dungeons, level 16 artifacts, and Resonance Level 79. He achieves over 6.28 billion total damage on Cloudtop Arbor Difficulty II using two dedicated teams: Aura and Poison. The video details hero gear sets, skill timings, and positioning for both teams. Additionally, he highlights that Azure Prophecy's debuff condition does not trigger on Corrosion DoT effects and demonstrates how upgrading artifacts to level 16 provided a 200 million damage boost.

teams.note: Aura team dealing 1.64B damage on Cloudtop Arbor Difficulty II with synchronized 18-second recast skill timings.
Poison team dealing 4.63B damage; relies on Child of Chaos for solo sustain.

tips: Do not waste resources maxing Lincos talents if you plan to bench him for higher-tier Aura heroes soon.
Ensure all hero artifacts are upgraded to level 16, as maxing artifact stats can net over 200 million extra damage in Temporal Vortex.
Azure Prophecy set effect requires non-damage debuffs; DoT effects like Poison or Corrosion will not grant Fate stacks.
To use Child of Chaos as a solo healer in Temporal Vortex, ensure he has Inspiration 2; otherwise, run additional sustain like Stegamoffyn or Areita.
title: These Changes Got My Massive Gains In The Vortex! Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
